promptTemplate:
Create a NEW illustration of a small traditional Korean archive/library hall (서고, seogo) in exactly the same illustrated-map style as the attached reference building (a hanok estate map: LOW-POLY FACETED planes -- every surface is broken into flat angular colour facets like folded paper, NO drawn outlines, matte finish, subtle hanji paper grain, warm wood/stone colours, top-left lighting, seen straight from the front in a slightly elevated view -- same camera as the reference).

The building: a single small raised one-story hanok with its own stone platform (raised higher than a normal room floor, the way a real seogo keeps books off damp ground), a solid plank-panelled front wall with small high ventilation windows (not the large lattice doors a living room would have), wooden post-and-beam frame, and a modest hipped tile roof -- visibly smaller and simpler than the reference building, with narrow closed eaves (no open veranda -- this building keeps its contents dry, not social).

Do not redraw the reference building; it is for style, palette, camera and lighting only. Show ONLY the seogo, fully finished, centred in the frame.

Flat pure #00FF00 chroma-key green background, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no people.

IMPORTANT COLOR: match the reference building's warm wood/stone/tile palette exactly -- do not brighten or desaturate.

ABSOLUTELY AVOID: smooth painterly rendering, soft gradients, watercolour blending, photorealism, glossy 3D render, black outlines, text, labels, a second building, people, large open doors (this building stays closed).

IMPORTANT: match the geometric faceted style, palette and mood of the attached reference exactly -- this must look like part of the same illustrated set.
subjectGuards: small high ventilation windows, not large lattice doors -- distinguishes it from a living room (sarangbang/anbang) at a glance
raised platform higher than the estate's other buildings -- reads as book storage, not a place to sit
exactly one building in frame -- reject if the model adds a second structure
no open veranda/toenmaru -- unlike byeoldang, this is a closed storage building

placement.note: 1536x1152 master canvas. Measured 2026-08-18: this region is 0.0% occupied. Sits just south of byeoldang's bbox -- if both ship, confirm they don't visually crowd each other before generating either.

status: DRAFT — Phase 3 P2, NOT executed. Needs Jin's visual approval before any generation call per the plan's explicit rule. Written 2026-08-18 while Jin was away so the recipe is ready to review on return, not to run unattended.
followUp: Once approved and generated, allowlist the finished PNG, author seogo_stages.json (s1_platform/s2_frame/s3_roof/s4_final -- draft grant catalog already reserves exactly these 4 revealAssetIds under hanok_estate_seogo_*), and a matching estate-frame-seogo.json frameEdit recipe. Also unblocks the deferred venue upgrade noted in the PR-A authoring script: PersonalRoomSurface.seogo + its PersonalRoomDefinition + interior background art (Phase 3 P8) should land together in one PR, not before this building exists.
